answer: Mechanism: Delta-rented zephyr channels. Each agent rents short-lived interaction channels; rent equals the marginal increase in network coordination cost caused by the agent’s unique-neighbor delta, settled in copper-denominated credits. Zephyr slots expire in seconds, so mass low-value sybils cannot amortize setup. An attacker spawning N identities pays N distinct channel rents plus repeated expiry renewals; parallel coordination multiplies cost with each new unique edge. Honest agents reuse few durable channels, paying low deltas.
